scope: Theorem 14.8 (Uniform computable template bound) of the manuscript “Finite congruence lattices: characterization and undecidability” (preprints/Finite-Congruence-Lattices-Characterization-and-Undecidability-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 206 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 d26d6cd6285de4f2), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 154-155. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The quote crosses a page break and includes whatever the extraction places there, such as a page number. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There is a total computable nondecreasing function Φ : Z≥0 → Z≥1 such that every weighted template F = [SZ × Y, SZ⊔( S T)] 154 of Section 13, with at most t units, excluding the foundation Z from this count, and |Z| > | S T|, satisfies |F| ≤ Φ(t). The bound is independent of all full-unit sizes, square sides, auxiliary axis lengths, offset sizes, and the size of Z. No stock-size hypothesis is required for this counting assertion.
